
[yellow bold]-- CONCURRENCY -- multiple_global_vars_mixed.volt:4[/yellow bold]

Variable `shared_flag` is shared between control (critical) and monitor. Each read and write is atomic in the generated C.

 [dim]3 |[/dim] var speed: int = 0
 [dim]4 |[/dim] var shared_flag: int = 0
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]    ^^^^^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: An update spread over several statements can still interleave; keep it in one statement or use a channel.[/cyan]
